import.about: All connections are downloaded. Monobank gives out the statement at most once a minute per token and at most 31 days per request: about a minute for each month of history of each account; the connections of different people go in parallel. The current month of all accounts comes first, then the history. You can stop the import and continue later. New transactions also arrive on their own — see «Auto-sync» in the settings.
import.cancelled: The import is stopped. What is downloaded is saved.

connections.description: The bank and the token the app reads your statement with. The token is read-only: it cannot move money. In «Accounts» you can switch an account off: it is not downloaded and is left out of the statistics.
connections.note: Connect someone else's account only with the token owner's consent. «Remove» erases the connection, its token and the downloaded transactions in this app; nothing changes at the bank.
connections.title: Connections

first.tagline: Where your money goes — from your statement, on your computer.

monobank.accessNote: The token only reads the statement and balances and is kept on this computer.
monobank.consent: The account owner issues the token in their own Monobank and gives it to you. The token opens all of their statements and balances for reading — add it only with their consent.
monobank.noSecureStorage: This computer has no secure key store: the token will not be saved, only kept in memory until the app closes.
monobank.step1: Open api.monobank.ua in a browser and sign in with the Monobank app (QR code).
monobank.step2: Copy your personal token and paste it here.

integrations.removeImportRunning: Stop the import first: it is writing these accounts right now.

row.accountsEmpty: Accounts appear after the first import.

integrations.tokenError: The token was not saved: check that the whole token is pasted, with no spaces.

deleteAll.detail: Downloaded transactions, the database key, saved tokens, the lock and an unfinished import will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

removeConnection.detail: Its token, accounts and transactions in this app will be deleted. Nothing changes at the bank. This cannot be undone.

startOver.detail: Downloaded transactions, people and their names, overrides and settings will be deleted. Saved tokens stay if they can be read — transactions are downloaded from the bank again. This cannot be undone.

autoSync.description: The app fetches new transactions of every connection by itself and rereads the last 31 days: that is how holds that have since completed or been cancelled catch up.
autoSync.enabledHint: The whole family: connections with a saved token.
autoSync.note: At most once every 30 minutes. Deeper history is downloaded with the «Download» button on the home screen.
autoSync.title: Auto-sync
autoSync.triggerInterval: Every 4 hours while the app is open
autoSync.triggerWake: When the computer wakes from sleep

dbEncryption.encrypted: The database on this computer is encrypted; the key is kept in {store}.
dbEncryption.noSecureStorage: The database is not encrypted: this computer has no secure key store (keyring). Once it has one, the app will encrypt the database on the next launch. For the same reason, tokens are kept in memory only.
dbEncryption.pending: Could not encrypt the database — the app will try again on the next launch.
dbEncryption.scope: Encryption protects a copy of the files: on another computer, in another user account, in a backup or in the cloud, the database cannot be opened. Programs running under your user account can get the key — that is what the app lock and disk encryption are for.
dbEncryption.title: Database encryption

dbRecovery.actionError: That did not work. Relaunch the app and try again.

detail.dbUnreadable: The database file is damaged or encrypted with another key.
detail.keyLost: The key the database is encrypted with can no longer be read (a reinstall without a signature, a deleted Keychain entry, a move to another computer). This database cannot be opened.

dbRecovery.startOverHint: «Start over» creates a new empty database: transactions are downloaded from the bank again, saved tokens stay if they can be read. People's names, overrides and settings are lost.

title.keyUnavailable: No access to the database key

unavailable.darwin: Allow access when Keychain asks — the request appears after a relaunch.
unavailable.linux: Unlock the keyring and relaunch the app.
unavailable.other: The system key store did not respond. Relaunch the app.

deleteData.body: Erases the transactions database and its key, saved tokens, the app lock and an unfinished import. Nothing changes at the bank, but the statement will have to be downloaded again. The app asks for confirmation before deleting.
deleteData.description: Everything the app has saved on this computer.
deleteData.error: Not everything could be deleted. Restart the app and try again.
deleteData.heading: Delete all data
deleteData.title: Data

lock.description: A PIN closes the app to anyone who sits down at your unlocked computer. It is a lock on the door, not encryption: the database is encrypted separately, with a key from the system store, and your user account can reach that key without the PIN.
lock.hintText: Closes the app when you step away from the computer. Turn it on in settings.
lock.hintTitle: New: lock with a PIN or Touch ID
lock.importRunning: An import is running — it keeps going while the app is locked.
lock.note: A forgotten PIN cannot be recovered — you can only delete all data.
lock.offHint: The app opens without a PIN.

pinProblem.same: All digits are the same — such a PIN is easy to guess.
pinProblem.sequence: The digits are in a row — such a PIN is easy to guess.

update.autoHint: 10 seconds after start and every 6 hours.
update.description: New versions come from GitHub and are installed only if signed by the author.
update.devBuild: Updates are not checked in a development build.

error.download: Could not download the update. Try again later.
error.mismatch: The downloaded update did not match its signed description — it was deleted and will not be installed.
error.offline: Could not check for updates: no connection to GitHub. Try again later.
error.rejected: The update failed the signature check and will not be installed.

update.importRunning: An import is running — the update installs once it finishes and the app closes.
update.note: Before installing, the file is checked against the signed description of the version: size and checksum. Going back to an older version is not possible.
update.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and checked — it installs on restart.
update.saved: Version {version} is downloaded and checked: «{file}» in the «Downloads» folder.
update.savedHelp: Open the file in «Downloads» and drag Balance Insights into «Applications», replacing the old one. macOS asks for your password once so the new version can read the saved token — choose «Always Allow». Your data and token stay.
update.title: Updates
